notes.title: New sequel in development!
notes.content:
Lot of people have been suggesting more modern rules like wall kicks and block holding, but i didn't want to change Centrist too much, so i decided to start working on sequel called Midtris.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748498/0c128a017f0f9e0ba05179a50fb0d7a4d4174374.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748498/1a6a769d193da4251eee7a738d9ac2318ac4ece2.png[/img]

How will Midtris differ from Centrist?

[list]
[*]SRS (Wall kicks)
[*]Block holding
[*]More pieces shown in next block displayer
[*]UI rework
[*]New game modes / game mode reworks
[*] Score rework (extra points for combos etc.)
[*] New music
[*] Lot of other improvements
[/list]

If you have any features you would like to see in Midtris let me know.

tags.feature: - SRS (Wall kicks)
- Block holding
- More pieces shown in next block displayer
- UI rework
- New game modes / game mode reworks
- Score rework (extra points for combos etc.)
- New music
- Lot of other improvements

notes.title: Centrist (V1.11)
notes.content:
Some people did not like default keybindings for gamepad so gamepad controls are now rebindable. "A" will remain as selection button even if you change rotate button to something else.

First song didn't have much time play compared to other songs since difficulties change much faster during early game so second song now starts slightly later. Also difficulty 7 didn't feel fast enough to match intensivity of 3rd song so it will now starts at difficulty 8.


[list]
[*] Gamepad controls are now rebindable
[*] Added restart button as rebindable button
[*] Second song now starts at difficulty 5 instead of 4
[*] Third song now starts at difficulty 8 instead of 7
[*] Fixed healthbar outline
[/list]

Added restart button as rebindable button

tags.balance_change: Second song now starts at difficulty 5 instead of 4
Third song now starts at difficulty 8 instead of 7

In classic mode collapse mechanic often shuffled blocks in unexpected ways and there wasn't any time to react since blocks started falling immediately after layers were cleared. Falling timer is now resetted after layers are cleared to give player some time to react to changes.

Added quit and restart buttons to game over screen. There is small delay before buttons can be pressed. (Mainly to prevent accidental selections when playing with mouse controls or gamepad)

[list]
[*] Falling timer is now resetted after layers are cleared
[*] Added quit and restart buttons to game over screen
[*] Fixed steam community screenshots not working (screenshot can be taken with F12)
[*] Fixed difficulty not updating after using flame
[*] Previously played game mode is now selected as first option in game mode selection and leaderboards
[/list]

notes.title: Centrist (V1.06)
notes.content:
Problem with higher difficulties was that there wasn't enough time to move blocks to side in case spawning area was blocked. There is now minimum 0.5 - 0.35 second delay before blocks start falling. This should be enough time to move blocks to other side of the board. Previously there was huge gap between lvl 10 and 11, but with this change even higher difficulties should become playable, so higher difficulties now start much sooner.


[list]
[*] There is now minimum delay of 0.5 - 0.35 seconds before blocks start falling
[*] Difficulty 11 now starts much sooner (750 blocks destroyed for Classic and 1000 for other modes)
[*] Added new music for difficulty 11
[*] Increased maximum difficulty from 20 to 23
[*] Fixed Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters not being displayed in leaderboards unless language was selected (It might still not work perfectly in all cases, but font is selected based on first letter of the name)
[/list]


[b]Hotfix:[/b]
Got worried that minimum delay would make higher difficulties too easy especially on bombastic and centrist modes. So minimum delay now starts decreasing after lvl 11.

[list]
[*] Minimum delay now starts decreasing after lvl 11 (capping at 0.35 seconds at lvl 20)
[/list]

tags.balance_change: There is now minimum delay of 0.5 - 0.35 seconds before blocks start falling
Difficulty 11 now starts much sooner (750 blocks destroyed for Classic and 1000 for other modes)

tags.feature: Added new music for difficulty 11

tags.balance_change: Increased maximum difficulty from 20 to 23

tags.bug: Fixed Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters not being displayed in leaderboards unless language was selected (It might still not work perfectly in all cases, but font is selected based on first letter of the name)

tags.balance_change: Minimum delay now starts decreasing after lvl 11 (capping at 0.35 seconds at lvl 20)
